title: 假設語氣
point: 假設語氣先看兩種訊號：要求、建議類動詞後面的 that 子句用原形動詞；If 子句跟事實相反時，時態往過去退一格。
formula: 主詞 + require / recommend / insist + that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（否定用 not + 原形動詞）

table.en: require that he submit the form
table.rule: 要求類動詞 + that + 主詞 + 原形動詞，不隨主詞加 s
建議類動詞的 that 子句同樣用原形動詞

table.en: insist that they not leave early
table.zh: 堅持他們不要提早離開
table.rule: 否定把 not 放在原形動詞前面

table.en: It is essential that each form be signed
table.rule: It is essential / important that + 主詞 + 原形動詞，被動用 be + 過去分詞

table.en: If we had known, we would have called
table.zh: 如果當時知道，我們就會打電話
table.rule: 與過去事實相反：If + had 過去分詞，would have 過去分詞

table.en: If we had more staff, we would finish sooner
table.zh: 如果人手多一點，就會早點完成
table.rule: 與現在事實相反：If + 過去式，would + 原形動詞

examples: The director recommends that each department submit its budget by June.
The client insisted that the supplier replace the damaged parts.
story: The HR manager reviewed the company's hiring process last week.
She recommended that every candidate complete a short writing test.
The CEO also insisted that the team not schedule interviews on Fridays.
If the company had used this process last year, it would have avoided several costly hiring mistakes.

drills.prompt: Can the team schedule interviews on Fridays?
drills.fix: insisted that the team not schedule 是堅持不要排，否定用 not + 原形動詞。

drills.prompt: She recommended that every candidate ___ a test.
drills.fix: recommend that 後面的子句用原形動詞，不隨主詞加 s，也不改過去式。

drills.prompt: Did the company use this process last year?
drills.fix: If + had 過去分詞表示跟過去事實相反，所以去年其實沒有用。
